title: Add provider capability and descriptor models
prompt: Start Phase 10 by adding provider-agnostic immutable models for provider identity and capabilities. Create src/ade/provider_routing.py with ProviderCapability values for at least GITHUB_SOURCE, AUTO_CREATE_PR, PLAN_APPROVAL, INTERACTIVE_MESSAGE, RESUME_SESSION, HOSTED_EXECUTION, and LOCAL_EXECUTION; a validated ProviderDescriptor containing provider_id, display_name, capabilities, priority, enabled, and optional cost_class; and a RoutingRequest containing required_capabilities plus optional allowed_provider_ids and preferred_provider_ids. Serialization must be deterministic and secret-free. Do not instantiate providers or read environment variables in these models. Export the public API from ade.__init__. Add focused stdlib tests for round-trip, capability normalization, duplicate/invalid capability rejection, stable provider IDs, preference validation, immutable caller inputs, and deterministic ordering. Do not add dependencies. Run PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v.
